scientific_integrity: The previously known Moore-space homotopy decomposition and its order-two homology are attributed to the cited 2020 work; the new claim is solely the minimal induced sphere carrier classification, integral spanning, and invariant chain representative.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns the canonical Paley tournament on eleven vertices and induced supports of size five, not all tournaments or larger supports.
Only a proposed self-review mathematical proof and deterministic reproducible code are supplied, not an independently validated discovery or a formal proof certificate.
Publication priority relative to unindexed specialized computations remains uncertain.
title: Fifty-five induced sphere carriers generate integral Paley-tournament homology
